verses.sanskrit:
दुर्योधन उवाच।
              यदाह विदुरः कृष्णे सर्वं तत् सत्यमच्युते। अनुरक्तो ह्यसंहार्यः पार्थान् प्रति जनार्दनः ॥१॥
verses.english: Duryodhana said What Vidura has said regarding Krishna has been truly spoken; for Janardana is firmly attached to the son of Pritha and inseparable from them.

verses.sanskrit: यत्तत्सत्कारसंयुक्तं देयं वसु जनार्दने। अनेकरूपं राजेन्द्र न तद्देयं कदाचन ॥२॥
verses.english: The diverse kinds of wealth therefore that is proposed to be bestowed on Janardana for his honour, O chief among kings, should on no account be given.

verses.sanskrit: देशः कालस्तथाऽयुक्तो न हि नार्हति केशवः। मंस्यत्यधोक्षजो राजन् भयादर्चति मामिति ॥३॥
verses.english: Though Keshava is worthy of all that, yet place and time render it in-expedient; for he will come to think on receiving our worship, O king, that we are honoring him out of fear.

verses.sanskrit: अवमानश्च यत्र स्यात् क्षत्रियस्य विशाम्पते। न तत् कुर्याद्बुधः कार्यमिति मे निश्चिता मतिः ॥४॥
verses.english: O Lord of the world, what would conduce to the disgrace of the Kshatriya race should not be done by a wise man. Such is my decided opinion.
verses.bhavadeepa: देश इति । यद्यपि केशवोऽर्चामर्हत्येव तथाऽप्यर्चायां देशः कालश्चायुक्त इत्यर्थः । तदेवाह - मंस्यतीति ॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: स हि पूज्यतमो लोके कृष्णः पृथुललोचनः। त्रयाणामपि लोकानां विदितं मम सर्वथा ॥५॥
verses.english: Krishna of big eyes is most worthy of worship in this world by all the three worlds. This fact is always present in my mind.

verses.sanskrit: न तु तस्मै प्रदेयं स्यात्तथा कार्यगतिः प्रभो। विग्रहः समुपारब्धो न हि शाम्यत्यविग्रहात् ॥६॥
verses.english: But circumstances are such, my lord, that nothing should be given him. War having been decided on will not turn into peace by delaying the former.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भीष्मः कुरुपितामहः। वैचित्रवीर्यं राजानामिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥७॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Bhishma, the grandfather of the Kurus, having heard these words of his said these words to the royal son of Vichitravirya.

verses.sanskrit: सत्कृतोऽसत्कृतो वाऽपि न क्रुद्ध्येत जनार्दनः। नालमेनमवज्ञातुं नावज्ञेयो हि केशवः ॥८॥
verses.english: Janardana will not get angry, whether he is properly received or not. He cannot be insulted; for Keshava is not capable of being SO.

verses.sanskrit: यत्तु कार्यं महाबाहो मनसा कार्यतां गतम्। सर्वोपायैर्न तच्छक्यं केनचित् कर्तुमन्यथा ॥९॥
verses.english: Whatever act, O you with long arms, is fructified in his mind's eye cannot be prevented by any man by every mean in his power.

verses.sanskrit: स यद्ब्रूयान्महाबाहुस्तत्कार्यमविशङ्कया। वासुदेवेन तीर्थेन क्षिप्रं संशाम्य पाण्डवैः ॥१०॥
verses.english: What that being with long arms says, should be done without hesitation. Effect peace quickly with the Pandavas through the instrumentality of Vasudeva.

verses.sanskrit: धर्म्यमर्थ्यं च धर्मात्मा ध्रुवं वक्ता जनार्दनः। तस्मिन् वाच्याः प्रिया वाचो भवता बान्धवैः सह ॥११॥
verses.english: Janardana, inclined to virtue, will surely say what is conducive to morality as well as worldly profit; and he should be spoken to in agreeable words by yourself along with your friends.

verses.sanskrit:
दुर्योधन उवाच।
              न पर्यायोऽस्ति यद्राजन् श्रियं निष्केवलामहम्। तैः सहेमामुपाश्नीयां यावज्जीवं पितामह ॥१२॥
verses.english: Duryodhana said Since, O king, there is no likelihood of my being the sole enjoy of royalty and since, O grandsire, I cannot share it for life with them.

verses.sanskrit: इदं तु सुमहत् कार्यं शृणु मे यत् समर्थितम्। परायणं पाण्डवानां नियच्छामि जनार्दनम् ॥१३॥
verses.english: Listen to this great deed which I have fixed in my mind. I shall make Janardana-the refuge of the Pandavas, the captive.
verses.bhavadeepa: पर्यायः प्रकारान्तरं निष्केवलां कृत्स्नां माण्डवान् यथा दासवद्वासयेयं तथा प्रकारो नास्तीत्यर्थः॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् बद्धे भविष्यन्ति वृष्णयः पृथिवी तथा। पाण्डवाश्च विधेया मे स च प्रातरिहैष्यति ॥१४॥
verses.english: On his imprisonment, the Vrishnis and the Pandavas, in fact the whole world, will be at my disposal. Krishna, too, will be here tomorrow morning.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रोपायान् यथा सम्यङ्न बुद्ध्येत जनार्दनः। न चापायो भवेत्कश्चित्तद्भवान् प्रब्रवीतु मे ॥१५॥
verses.english: Some means for executing this in such a way that Janardana may not at all anticipate it; and so that we way not fall into any danger, should be told me by you.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा घोरं कृष्णाभिसंहितम्। धृतराष्ट्रः सहामात्यो व्यथितो विमनाऽभवत् ॥१६॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Hearing these words of terrible import, namely of making of making Krishna a captive, Dhritarashtra with his ministers became oppressed with pain.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दुर्योधनमिदं धृतराष्ट्रोऽब्रवीद्वचः। मैवं वोचः प्रजापाल नैष धर्मः सनातनः ॥१७॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra then said these words to Duryodhana, do not say so, O you protector of men. This is against eternal virtue.

verses.sanskrit: दूतश्च हि हृषीकेशः सम्बन्धी च प्रियश्च नः। अपापः कौरवेयेषु स कथं बन्धमर्हति ॥१८॥
verses.english: Hrishikesha is an ambassador; and in relation he is dear to ourselves. He has done no wrong to the Kurus. How then is it proper that he should be made a captive?

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              परीतस्तव पुत्रोऽयं धृतराष्ट्र सुमन्दधीः। वृणोत्यनर्थं नैवार्थं याच्यमानः सुहृज्जनैः ॥१९॥
verses.english: Bhishma said This wicked son of yours, O Dhritarashtra, is on the verge of eternity. He selects the evil and not what is good, though begged by persons who wish well to him.

verses.sanskrit: इममुत्पथि वर्तन्तं पापं पापानुबन्धिनम्। वाक्यानि सुहृदां हित्वा त्वमप्यस्यानुवर्तसे ॥२०॥
verses.english: Instead of listening to the advice of your well-wishers, you too follow him, who is established on this unrighteous path and whose surroundings are sinful.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णमक्लिष्टकर्माणमासाद्यायं सुदुर्मतिः। तव पुत्रः सहामात्यः क्षणेन न भविष्यति ॥२१॥
verses.english: This son of Dhritarashtra of exceedingly wicked purposes, along with his advisers, will cease to exist in a moment when he comes against Krishna, who can do a work without the least trouble.

verses.sanskrit: पापस्यास्य नृशंसस्य त्यक्तधर्मस्य दुर्मतेः। नोत्सहेऽनर्थसंयुक्ताः श्रोतुं वाचः कथञ्चन ॥२२॥
verses.english: I dare not listen to any words of this man of wicked purpose, who has abandoned virtue and who is cruel and sinful.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा भरतश्रेष्ठो वृद्धः परममन्युमान्। उत्थाय तस्मात् प्रातिष्ठद्भीष्मः सत्यपराक्रमः ॥२३॥
verses.english: Having said this, the foremost of aged men among the Bharata Bhishma of true prowess got up and went away from that place, fired with great rage.
